item.title: DNA leads to cold case rape trial, life sentence, in Conway
item.description: An unsolved 2004 rape was brought to court after DNA identified a suspect.

item.title: Alexis Ray Parker on vulnerability in songwriting, mental health & getting spark for new music | Arkansas Soul Sessions
item.description: Alexis Ray Parker joined in on a session with Miriam B. to talk about openness in her songwriting throughout her projects, her experiences with mental health and new music coming this year.

item.title: Bryant battles Conway, Pulaski Academy takes on Forrest City | Fearless Friday Basketball
item.description: The Fearless Friday team recapped the best highlights from the Arkansas high school basketball playoffs, featuring wins by Farmington, Bryant, Benton, Little Rock Central, North Little Rock, Pulaski Academy, Har-Ber, and Bentonville West.

item.title: Little Rock veteran, volunteer firefighter reunites with MEMS crew that saved his life
item.description: A man who has dedicated his life to serving others got a chance on Friday to thank the people who saved his life, 10 months after a heart attack nearly took it.

item.title: Power outages pop up on Saturday as severe weather moves across Arkansas
item.description: As severe weather moves through Arkansas on Saturday, power outages begin to grow.

item.title: Arkansas Storm Team Forecast: Saturday Severe Update
item.description: Showers and thunderstorms rolling through the state on Saturday, March 7. A lot of the state is no longer under a severe threat, but flooding continues.

item.title: Human remains found in remote area of Hot Spring County, sheriff says
item.description: The Hot Spring County Sheriff's Office is investigating after human remains were discovered in a remote part of the county, and the remains have been sent to the Arkansas State Crime Laboratory for identification.

item.title: GALLERY: Arkansas Travelers alumni participating in the 2026 World Baseball Classic
item.description: The 2026 World Baseball Classic will feature several current and former Arkansas Travelers, including Team USA's Cal Raleigh, Team Dominican Republic's Julio Rodríguez, Team Panama's Jose Caballero, Team Colombia's Michael Arroyo, Team Israel's Charlie Beilenson, Team Canada coach Stubby Clapp, and Team Great Britain's Harry Ford.

item.title: Central Arkansas beats Florida Gulf Coast, advances to ASUN tournament final
item.description: The Central Arkansas Bears men's basketball team won their ASUN semifinal game against Florida Gulf Coast University 73-63, earning a spot in the ASUN Championship game and a chance to make it to the Big Dance.

item.title: 1 dead, 1 arrested after Little Rock pursuit on Friday
item.description: One person was killed and another injured after a police pursuit in Little Rock, Arkansas, led to a crash, resulting in the arrest of 37-year-old Patrick Hardy on several charges, including capital murder.
